verdict.rationale: Convex's docs say it provides client libraries alongside its database and server functions. They list official language support for JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin and Rust, plus framework integrations for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte and others. The CLI also generates end-to-end TypeScript types, which helps agents build against the SDK safely. Missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK reference documentation or API detail beyond list mentions, evidence on SDK maturity and parity across languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
